meta.name: crm-prospect-mining
meta.description: Mine high-value prospects from CRM pipeline stages (Lost, No Show, Churned, Stalled) by cross-referencing records with LinkedIn company data and comms history. Connects to any CRM, pulls records from target stages, filters out personal email domains, bulk-scrapes company sizes via Apify, and filters by the user's "high-value" definition (headcount, industry, deal size). MANDATORY TRIGGERS: "find high-value prospects", "mine my lost deals", "reactivate pipeline", "prospect mining", "CRM mining", "re-engage lost leads", "company size analysis", "headcount filter", or any request about identifying which CRM prospects are worth pursuing based on company size, industry, or intent signals.

copy.tagline: 从CRM流失客户中挖掘高价值潜在客户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手上有大量CRM流失客户，想找出值得重新跟进的高价值线索。
copy.tagline_en: Mine high-value prospects from lost CRM deals
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a CRM with lost deals and want to find which ones are worth re-engaging.
